title: Two Years Later, Jujutsu Kaisen’s Ending Is As Controversial As Fans Remember
content: There’s no denying Jujutsu Kaisen is one of the biggest Shonen Jump series of all time, even though it was only released in recent years. Written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, the manga began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2018 before reaching its conclusion in 2024.
